Rice.description: High water-requirement semi-aquatic cereal crop sensitive to moisture deficit during flowering and tillering.
Rice.source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 (Crop Evapotranspiration); ICAR Rice Agronomy Handbook

Wheat.description: Temperate rabi cereal sensitive to high terminal heat stress and moisture stress at crown root initiation.
Wheat.source: FAO Crop Water Information; Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) Wheat Production Manual

Maize.description: C4 cereal crop highly susceptible to water deficit during silking and tasseling stages.
Maize.source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 33 (Yield response to water); CIMMYT Agronomy Guidelines

Cotton.description: Deep-rooted cash crop sensitive to waterlogging as well as severe moisture stress during squaring.
Cotton.source: ICAR-Central Institute for Cotton Research (CICR) Technical Bulletin

Pulses.description: Leguminous protein crops with low water demand; intolerant to excessive standing water and drainage impedance.
Pulses.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Pulses Research (IIPR) Package of Practices

Sugarcane.description: Long-duration perennial grass requiring sustained water availability throughout formative and grand growth phases.
Sugarcane.source: FAO Crop Water Information: Sugarcane; ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute

Soybean.description: Major oilseed and protein crop sensitive to drought stress during pod initiation and seed filling.
Soybean.source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Soybean Research (IISR) Guidelines

Groundnut.description: Oilseed legume requiring adequate moisture during pegging and pod development; prone to pod rot if waterlogged.

Mustard.description: Rabi oilseed crop sensitive to elevated temperature during flowering and pod development.

Millets.description: Drought-resilient hardy grain crop capable of sustaining production in marginal moisture conditions.
